about: The one release variant table. .github/workflows/release.yml reads every list from it through tools/release/publish_candidate.py plan: the envs it builds, the image each env becomes, the gates per image, the signed manifest pairs, the web-flash images and the published assets. variants: the stable rows in build order; type is the device TYPE (NVS otaType, the typed-manifest key, frozen), env the PlatformIO env that builds it, image the release asset name. candidate: shipped empty; a tag equal to candidate.tag builds only candidate.variants (each a stable type and the env that builds it), publishes a pre-release with no manifest.json and no web-flash, and attaches manifest-candidate.json to the latest full release. hold_line: empty, e1 or e2 (holdHeads only when set). releases_repo: the one place the releases repository is named; a run from any repository but ristllin/Nimbus that would publish to ristllin/nimbus-fw-releases is refused. Writers: RB-REL0 (the table), RB-R2 (the candidate entry), RB-FLIP (each stable row's env).
